ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixel distribution with a very low ratio of high-intensity (white) pigmentation across the macro-level surface, excluding localized anomalies.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous dark pixel mapping across the entire visible ventral fluke; no high-contrast contiguous geometric blobs or mottling patterns are present on the primary surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a deep, acute interior angle and symmetrical convergence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular serration profile characterized by high-frequency jagged peaks and deep valleys along the continuous trailing boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve fitted to both lobes, sweeping superiorly toward pointed lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of circular, high-intensity white pixel groupings (barnacles) concentrated heavily along the leading edges and distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of three parallel, vertically-oriented, high-contrast linear disruptions (rake marks) on the inner-superior region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct vertical rake marks on the left fluke lobe and extensive peripheral epibiont (barnacle) colonization.
other_distinctive_markers: Significantly irregular and saw-toothed topography along the entire trailing edge boundary.
